text:
mika: T-minus 1h to the 09:00 UTC deploy. Quick owner check and smoke run plan — please reply with your role and a short ack. We need someone to watch latency dashboard, someone for canary rollback, owner for DB migration gate, and an infra on-call for any infra flakiness.

jade: I can monitor latency and error rates (Grafana lane). I’ll keep a note of the threshold: p95 < 220ms, error-rate < 0.5%. :white_check_mark:

owen: I’m on canary rollback owner. I’ll be ready to flip the toggle and initiate rollback plan if canary error-rate > 1% or end-to-end failure on core flow.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved by @mika for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Canary traffic target: 2% -> 10% over 10m -> full ramp 30m. Rollback hook enabled.

leah: DB migration gate: I’ll gate the migration toggle and confirm table-level locks are clean. Checklist: - migration dry-run done, - migration backfill rate < 50r/s, - backups verified. I’ll post ✅ when gate passes.

samir: Code review quick check: last PR merged 08:15 UTC, release notes updated. I sanity-checked healthcheck changes. No schema changes other than an index add (safe).

mika: Thanks. Quick smoke steps for anyone on call:```bash
# smoke tests
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood-inference.prod/health || echo fail
python ./tests/e2e/smoke_prompt.py --timeout 8 --samples 3
```

jade: I’ll run the API latency dashboard and post screenshots if p95 creeps. Will also watch token throughput in Console -> Routes -> inference.

leah: Migration dry-run looks good. Backups complete. I give the DB gate ✅. No table locks observed.

mika: Rollout cadence: canary 2% for 10m, then 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. If anything between checks fails, we stop and rollback. Owning runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/rollback (please DM if access issues).

owen: Acknowledged. I’ll be on standby at +1 if rollback needed. Have the rollback playbook open and staging snapshots ready.

samir: Smoke e2e results: 3/3 pass, latencies within range. small log WARNING in decoder path but not impacting outputs. Skipping deploy if we think it’s risky? :thinking_face:

mika: Noted about the warning. Owen, any red flags on rollback complexity?

owen: Warning looks non-blocking from my view; we should proceed but keep an eye. If we see elevated logged exceptions or user-facing regressions in the next 20m, we abort.

jade: :thumbsup: I’m good to proceed. I’ll post live p95 snapshots at 09:05 and 09:20.

mika: OK go/no-go? Please reply with a single word ack.

jade: go

leah: go

owen: go

samir: go

mika: Deploy kickoff in 2m. I’ll trigger the canary patch and ping this thread when traffic ramps. Keep your channels open and @mika if immediate rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated by @mika at 09:00 UTC. Canary traffic: 2%. Monitoring hooks active.

mika: Thanks everyone — I’ll post status updates here. Last message before kickoff: double-check any lingering feature flags tied to this roll.

jader: (reacted :thumbsup: to mika)
